Prime central Shanghai: hotel sits between People's Square (人民广场, ~3 min walk) and The Bund (外滩, ~8 min walk); Nanjing East Road Pedestrian Street (南京东路步行街) runs parallel — ideal for evening strolling, neon-lit street food, and souvenir shopping. Metro Lines 1/2/8 at People's Square station (人民广场站) give seamless city-wide access. The Bund night walk (外滩夜景) is a short stroll from the front door — perfect first stop after Matilde and Jade reunite arriving from Xi'an and Beijing respectively. Note: Tianzifang (田子坊) and Huaihai Road (淮海路) are farther than from the French Concession — allow ~20 min by metro or taxi.
